entities.name: Q6G1R8
observations: Exact sequence match (180 aa) to reviewed Bartonella henselae ribosome maturation factor RimM; annotated as a cytoplasmic accessory factor in 30S subunit assembly and efficient 16S rRNA processing.
Sequence-derived estimates: 19.84 kDa; theoretical pI 6.09. Pfam: RimM domain (PF01782) and PRC domain (PF05239). No explicit catalytic reaction retrieved.
